from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    base = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_modes = [Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0] for row in grid]
    col_modes = [Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0]
                 for c in range(w)]
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color != base]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color != base]
    if len(rows) < 2 or len(cols) < 2:
        return []
    line_counts = Counter(row_modes[r] for r in rows)
    line_counts.update(col_modes[c] for c in cols)
    line = line_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # In some inputs the left grid boundary is marked only on separator rows,
    # so its column mode is background; retain it as the first grid crossing.
    if cols and cols[0] > 0 and grid[rows[0]][0] == line:
        cols = [0] + cols

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        outrow = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                       grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]])
            v = corners[0]
            outrow.append(v if v != line and all(x == v for x in corners) else base)
        out.append(outrow)

    marked = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != base]
    if not marked:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in marked), max(r for r, _ in marked)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in marked), max(c for _, c in marked)
    return [row[c0:c1+1] for row in out[r0:r1+1]]
